limits: docker access on the host is root-equivalent: separation of service identities on one host, not host isolation
the broker trusts every allowed peer uid for every tenant (tenant authority: design path item 2)
holder strings are trusted within one service identity
a key already issued writes until the next CAS or its 1 h expiry (C12 a)
the operator directory is mounted into the app container for this test only

H6e: the default role-key mode (WP_BROKER unset) has no tenant isolation: the projector role key holds manage and create_index on every tenant's names and can re-point any tenant's alias; only broker-minted keys are tenant- and epoch-scoped; a broker-mode deployment must not mint or place the role keys where the application runs
H6e C14d: whether a writer key can update its own tenant's mapping is observed, not assumed (see C14.d.own_mapping); tenant-local, reported, not judged
